why: Mutations whose Negative subjects rows are incomplete: each fails these ids, outside its row, for a real coupling the row does not name. tokens-without-a-yes fails GA-STW-4: a toggle applied inline is refused toggle_only, and with a token on every step above reversible it is sent and runs; the row should name GA-STW-4 beside GA-TIER-2 and GA-APPLY-3 (a standards fix slice 2b proposes). ignores-leases fails GA-STW-4: GA-STW-4's reason order places leased (already before leased, leased before occupancy), which a steward that ignores leases cannot show; the row should name GA-STW-4 beside GA-LEASE-1 to 4 (a standards fix slice 3b proposes). Slice 5: tokens-without-a-yes also fails GA-SCN-3, GA-SCN-7 and GA-SCN-11, a run's unanswered ask being dispatched with a token, so it no longer ends skipped(not_confirmed); refuses-the-toggle fails GA-SCN-3 and GA-SCN-11, a run's toggle step refused rather than asked (and, in a person's run, re-asked); authors-a-toggle fails GA-SCN-11, a rule-started run's toggle step sent with an authored token, so no skipped(toggle_only) is listed. Each row should name these ids (standards fixes slice 5 proposes). Slice 7: ignores-leases also fails GA-STW-7, whose history case reads the lease an outside change took and the rule's step that lease refused; a steward that ignores leases records neither. The row should name GA-STW-7 (a standards fix slice 7 proposes). Slice 11: ignores-leases also fails GA-PERSIST-2, whose restart case reads a member's lease and a run's lease kept and released across the restart; notices-a-late-launch fails GA-PERSIST-2, whose case reads that a late_ack the applier gave while the steward was down lands the held notice of a failed(no_ack), which that mutation keeps. Each row should name GA-PERSIST-2 (standards fixes slice 11 proposes). Steward 0.11: conditions-fire-once also fails GA-RULE-8, whose case reads a failed lock noticed again on a second night and a skipped(occupancy_unknown) noticed again after its room was known in between, each needing the rule to become true a second time; fires-in-an-exception fails GA-LEASE-4, whose case reads a lease that refused a rule ending inside the rule's exception and the rule not fired; refuses-an-announcing-channel fails GA-NOTE-1, whose case holds a notice with an announcing speaker as the only channel (its clause needs that list). Each row should name these ids (standards fixes the steward-follows-0.11 spike proposes for 0.12).
